sampling.normalization: u_j=(x_j-lower_j)/(upper_j-lower_j); common declared domain, not subset extrema; five equally weighted variables
sampling.conventions: R is roof rise, D span, B longitudinal length, h eave height. Wind Angle=0 normal to ridge, 90 parallel to ridge (existing Figure 1). This differs from validation tap angle.

metrics.d_min: Minimum Euclidean pairwise distance in [0,1]^5; larger means greater closest-pair separation.
metrics.CD_squared: (13/12)^5 - (2/N) sum_i prod_j[1+|u_ij-1/2|/2-|u_ij-1/2|^2/2] + (1/N^2) sum_ik prod_j[1+|u_ij-1/2|/2+|u_kj-1/2|/2-|u_ij-u_kj|/2]. Lower is more uniform. No square root.

sampling.limits: Descriptive diagnostics for realized quantized designs. Sample size affects both metrics; emphasize matched N. Neither proves causal improvement in ML accuracy, global interpolation, or extrapolation.

convergence.uncertainty: Arithmetic mean +/- sample SD over three predefined seeds. ANN: folds, inner split, initialization, dropout and stopping. SVR: shuffled OOF folds; final fit deterministic. Fixed, not wholly nested subsets. No subset-realization uncertainty, confidence intervals, equivalence tests or sampling-size selection from test.

timer_definitions.final_fit_pipeline_seconds: final/fit.json seconds: training-only scaler fits, construction, fitting and model/scaler serialization. For ANN final epochs are the median of outer-fold epoch selections; final timer excludes inner selection. Corrected RF records also include parent-parameter checks and their small audit JSON write.
timer_definitions.prediction_20_cases_seconds: result.json test.predict_seconds: one already-loaded 20x5 to 20x315 batch including X scaling and Y inverse scaling; excludes loading and metric evaluation, no repeated benchmark.
timer_definitions.cv_fit_pipeline_seconds_sum: Sum of candidate fold fit.json seconds, includes ANN inner epoch selection plus outer refit. Does not time CV scoring/IO/other overhead as a whole.
timer_definitions.cv_prediction_seconds_sum: Sum of saved candidate fold evaluation.json predict_seconds.
timer_definitions.total_seconds: result.json total_seconds spans all candidate CV, selection, final fit and test, including intermediate IO and scoring; excludes final COMPLETE hashing. Not historical tuning time.

timing.hardware_limit: Run metadata records OS, architecture, packages and thread limit, but no CPU model, RAM, host identity or GPU-use evidence. Do not retrospectively attribute all ML records to author-reported CFD hardware or rank timings as a controlled benchmark.

cfd_author_report.characterization: Approximate typical observed wall-clock time per original-campaign CFD run; not controlled benchmark or exact average.
cfd_author_report.source: Author task dated 2026-09-27. No hardware record in supplied validation CSVs; no contradictory hardware evidence encountered in this bounded inspection. Integrated GPU not claimed as used.

timing.evaluator_sha256_note: The legacy scalar hash describes retained earlier records; per-model hashes identify the code used by each current record.

provenance.selection: Existing sampling diagnostics, all 54 timing records, and 20 final convergence rows with their recorded settings and retained subset IDs. Values copied without statistical recalculation. Previous-version curves, audit discrepancies, backups and operational instructions excluded.
provenance.timing_units: Timing fields ending in _seconds or _seconds_sum retain seconds. cfd_author_report.minutes_range retains minutes. No JSON timing unit conversion.
provenance.external_artifacts: Research-relative paths identify source datasets, model/scaler files, code and run metadata obtainable from the corresponding author; they are not files distributed in this ZIP.

rf_update.scope: Eight RF records and times replaced; three paired RF comparisons recomputed; 46 other evaluations retained. Historical search domains added separately.

prior_CFD_validation.scope: Prior research; outside the reproduction objectives of this ML repository.
